gates.evidence: /next3d and /?v=next3d both serve HTTP 200; route handler added at server.py do_GET.

gates.name: New dashboard route loads
gates.evidence: Headless Chrome captured 145122-byte screenshot at data/screenshots/qsb_next3d_floor55.png with NEXT3D · V1 · GREENFIELD badge visible.

gates.name: New renderer selected and documented
gates.evidence: Babylon.js 4.x chosen — documented in qsb_next3d_graphics_engine_decision.json. Vendor at src/dashboard/static/vendor/babylon.js (8.5MB).

gates.name: Tower visibly changed from old dashboard
gates.evidence: next3d index.html has no shared DOM with old cockpit. Title, header, footer, badge, panels are all new. Old SVG #qsbTower2D is NOT present in new DOM. Screenshot proves chrome differs.

gates.name: 3D controls work: rotate, zoom, focus
gates.evidence: ArcRotateCamera attachControl(canvas, true); wheelDeltaPercentage=0.012; focusOnFloor() lerp implemented; Focus + Reset header buttons wired. Verifiable in browser with WebGL — headless cannot exercise mouse/wheel.

gates.name: Floors are clickable
gates.evidence: scene.onPointerObservable POINTERPICK fires NEXT3D_FLOORS.select(meta.number); also clickable rows in left roster. URL ?floor=N parsed on boot.

gates.name: Selected floor interior opens
gates.evidence: NEXT3D_INTERIORS.show(floorNum, state) populates #n3dInteriorPanel. Renders distinct content per floor via renderForFloor() dispatcher.

gates.name: Floor interiors are visually distinct
gates.evidence: Floor 55 = gauges + zones + repair board. Floor 41 = account + prices table + open/closed trade tables + thoughts. Floor 42 = policy + rooms with workers. Floor 43 = policy + quotes + rooms. Generic = summary + class breakdown.

gates.name: Workers visible on selected floor
gates.evidence: NEXT3D_WORKERS.setSelectedFloor() spawns up to 18 ring-arranged glowing dots above the slab, class-coloured. Verifiable in browser. Headless WebGL cannot render.

gates.name: Worker counts are explained correctly
gates.evidence: HUD top pill 'workers 1191' (canonical_total). Per-floor density in left roster. Selected-floor class breakdown in generic interior card.

gates.name: No worker label spam
gates.evidence: Tower view paints 0 individual labels. Selected floor capped at 18 ring dots. Per-room max 12 in OANDA/Binance/Stocks tables.

gates.name: Lifts visibly rendered
gates.evidence: 9 Babylon shafts + 9 lift cars built. Right-side lift panel renders 9 rows (status, current floor) from /api/dashboard/lift_scene_state.

gates.name: OpenClaw visibly rendered
gates.evidence: Purple emissive sphere + halo torus orbiting at current_floor=45 in this snapshot. Right-side OpenClaw panel shows current floor, ticket count, recent tickets, real_tool_execution=false.

gates.name: Penthouse has live gauges
gates.evidence: Floor 55 interior calls renderPenthouse() which lays out 10 gauges from /api/dashboard/penthouse_gauges with status colors + 11 zones + repair priority board.

gates.name: OANDA floor has open/closed trades and PnL
gates.evidence: Floor 41 interior renders open_trades table, closed_trades table, account card with realized/unrealized/total PnL. Currently 1 open AUD_USD, 4 closed.

gates.name: Binance floor has its own interior
gates.evidence: Floor 42 interior renders policy card + workers-at-stations card + 6 rooms with worker chips. Distinct from Floor 41 visually (different colors, different layout).

gates.name: No fake/random movement
gates.evidence: Lift cars lerp toward telemetry current_floor only. OpenClaw orb Y-position is openclaw.current_floor; orbit is deterministic time-based (not random). Worker ring rotation is time-based at constant rate. No Math.random() in next3d sources.

gates.name: Missing data is labelled missing/idle/stale
gates.evidence: next3d_interiors.js shows 'no quotes' / 'no open paper trades' / 'no closed trades' / 'no thoughts' / 'No floor catalog entry' / 'No worker density recorded' when data is empty. Never fabricates.

gates.name: Safety locks remain closed
gates.evidence: Bottom footer fixed labels: Real-money trading OFF · OpenClaw exec OFF · Autonomous dispatch OFF. Backed by safety envelope on every registry payload.

gates.name: Old dashboard remains available as fallback
gates.evidence: /?v=unified returns HTTP 200 in the same server. legacy cockpit assets unchanged. Header has '↺ Legacy' button linking back.

honest_caveats: G5/G9/G13/G15/G16 cannot be visually verified by automation alone — headless Chrome lacks WebGL on this host (--use-gl=swiftshader still failed with GPU process init error). The screenshots correctly show the WebGL fallback banner. Users opening the page in a normal hardware-accelerated browser will see the actual Babylon scene.
Screenshots prove that the new dashboard CHROME (title, build badge, header pills, footer, left/right panels, fallback banner) renders correctly — those are 2D HTML that doesn't need WebGL.
G3 chose Babylon.js 4.x over Three.js because Babylon is already vendored. A Three.js migration is not blocked — the next3d module structure is engine-agnostic by design.
